items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: we got to Berlin there and we had [Greenley] and Drayton, famous dance team.

ctx.x: Oh, man, we got there -- we got to Berlin there and we had [Greenley] and Drayton, famous dance team. And we right straight to the theater, we were late getting there and I'll never forget, we were in the dressing room, getting ready to go on the stage and I looked up -- out the window and saw all these waiters coming round the street, around the corner all carrying trays of food, and I didn't know what the heck was going on, they were bringing us food cause
we didn't have time to eat. And they were all coming in, all beautifully dressed and waiting on us, bringing us food at the dressing rooms to eat.
